name: permission-request
description: Codex approval request → PermissionRequest → resolved; chain may yield followUpPrompt

permissionFlow.request: permission.requested → Gateway approval store (source of truth) → user decides → permission.respond → adapter
permissionFlow.followUp: Codex plan-approval chains may return followUpPrompt in PermissionResponseResult; GATEWAY executes it as a NEW turn with NEW gatewayTurnId — adapter never self-runs

notes: getPendingPermissions() on the session is a MIRROR only.
